description: Phase D (conformance / telemetry rewrite). Close the one known KCS gap DESIGN.md names: KMI delta-I gives every NLE projection an asset-id <-> path media map, and KCS §5 has NO predicate to read one. Add a `media_map_complete(projection)` predicate to the console's §5 media assertion vocabulary (`console/src/kcs/assertions.ts` `ASSERTION_PLANES.media`, alongside asset_attaches_to / source_world_is / analysis_attributed_to_constituent) that reads the KMI delta-I media map and asserts every projected asset id resolves to a path. Cross-repo: gated on koine's KMI delta-I media map. Evaluated over plane-typed observations, never generated text (§7 Q2). agora gates on `make check`; the console gates on `make check-console`.

userStories.title: Add media_map_complete(projection) to the §5 media vocabulary
userStories.description: Add the `media_map_complete` predicate to `ASSERTION_PLANES.media` with an evaluator that reads a KMI delta-I NLE projection's asset-id <-> path media map and asserts every asset id in the projection resolves to a path — the KCS §5 predicate for the map that had none.
acceptanceCriteria: `media_map_complete` is added to `ASSERTION_PLANES.media` (and thereby `ASSERTION_NAMES`) with an evaluator reading the KMI delta-I asset-id<->path media map; it is evaluated over the plane-typed media observation, never generated text (§7 Q2).
The predicate is registered on the media plane so a scenario naming it is not a silently-ignored assertion; `make check-console` green.

userStories.title: Test complete vs dangling maps
userStories.description: Pin the predicate with tests: it passes when the projection's media map is complete, and fails when a projected asset id has no path (a dangling entry), mirroring the console's existing assertion-evaluator test shape.
acceptanceCriteria: A test asserts `media_map_complete` returns a passing verdict for a complete media map and a failing verdict for a projection with a dangling asset id (an id with no path), and reports through the standard `AssertionVerdict` path.
`make check-console` green; no other §5 predicate's behaviour changes.
